definitions.explanation: A device or app that counts the number of steps a person takes. Used for health and fitness tracking.

examples.japanese: {歩数計|ほすうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walk with a pedometer on.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歩数計|ほすうけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歩数|ほすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}している→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: I record my daily steps with my smartphone's pedometer.

examples.japanese: {歩数計|ほすうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}たら→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一万歩|いちまんぽ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いていた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: When I checked my pedometer, I had walked as many as 10,000 steps today.

notes:
Composed of {歩数|ほすう} (step count) + ⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧ (meter/gauge). Refers to any device or app that counts steps.

USAGE:
Originally a standalone clip-on device, now commonly a built-in feature of smartphones and smartwatches. Still widely used in Japan, where the {一万歩|いちまんぽ} (10,000 steps per day) health goal remains popular.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歩数計|ほすうけい}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: pedometer app
- {歩数計|ほすうけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧: to wear a pedometer
- {歩数計|ほすうけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure with a pedometer
